meta.title: Revoke after the vendor already answered
gaps: Directly revoke an already accepted counter offer and verify the specific refusal message "No active counter offer found to modify" from the stale buyer page.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly revoke an already accepted counter offer and verify the specific refusal message "No active counter offer found to modify" from the stale buyer page.

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ responses screen with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Ensure counter offers are visible for RFQs.
Enable vendor counter-offer modification behavior required by the scenario.
Ensure the eRFX project configuration required by the setup is active.
Send the buyer's counter offer against Vendor A's normal bid.
Verify the buyer grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as initiated.
Have Vendor A accept the pending counter offer in the supplier portal.
Verify the buyer grid records Vendor A's counter offer as accepted.

args.because: No active counter offer found to modify

steps.note: Attempt the unavailable post-acceptance revoke action and capture any refusal evidence the UI provides.
Verify Vendor A's accepted price remains 90 after the attempted revoke.
